tools.name: listApps
tools.description:
Action: Lists all Memberstack apps the dashboard user can access.
Use When: Discovering available apps before selecting one with switchApp.
Details: Apps are complete projects with isolated members, plans, data tables, gated content, and settings. Returns role permissions (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBERS_READ/MEMBERS_WRITE) and creation dates.
Returns: Array of App objects with access details.

tools.name: getMemberstackEnvironment
tools.description:
Action: Returns the current environment (LIVE or SANDBOX) for member operations.
Use When: Checking which member dataset will be used before member operations.
Details: Environment setting ONLY affects member-related tools (getMember, getMembers, createMemberEmailPassword, updateMember, deleteMember, etc.). All other tools automatically use LIVE mode and ignore this setting. LIVE = production members; SANDBOX = test members.
Returns: Environment object with current mode.

tools.name: switchMemberstackEnvironment
tools.description:
Action: Switches environment for member operations only.
Use When: Need to work with test members (SANDBOX) instead of production members (LIVE).
Details: This setting ONLY affects member-related tools. All other tools (createCustomField, createDataTable, createPlan, etc.) automatically use LIVE mode and ignore this setting. Use SANDBOX when testing with fake member data; use LIVE for real production members.
Requires: Environment value (LIVE or SANDBOX).
Returns: Confirmation with new environment mode.

environment.description: Use LIVE for production members and SANDBOX for test data (aka staging).

tools.name: currentApp
tools.description: Retrieves the active app context (members, plans, data tables, gated content). Use to verify which app is selected or check environment mode before operations — SANDBOX is testing with Stripe test cards, LIVE is production with real payments. Returns null if no app is selected; call switchApp first. The App object includes configuration, environment mode, user role, and a domains array where each domain has its own LIVE/SANDBOX mode (so one app can mix modes across domains).

tools.name: getMembers
tools.description:
Lists members (end-users, distinct from dashboard users), newest first; pass order: "ASC" for oldest first. Filter with `filters` (planIds, status, noPlans, hasComments, noComments, segmentId) and `search` (a mem_ ID, or text matched against email and custom field values). Environment-specific (SANDBOX or LIVE); use switchMemberstackEnvironment to target the correct dataset. Each row has id, email, dates, verified, and planConnections with the plan's id and name; use getMember for full details.
Paging: returns at most 15 members per call, whatever `first` asks for. While pageInfo.hasNextPage is true, call again with the same filters, search and order, and set `after` to pageInfo.endCursor. Never pass a member ID as `after`. pageInfo.totalCountOfFilter is how many members match `filters` or `search`; it is 0 when you pass neither, so use getMembersCount for the app's total.

tools.name: createPrice
tools.description:
Action: Creates a paid price point for a plan and syncs with Stripe.
Use When: Launching new billing options (monthly/annual subscriptions, one-time purchases, or team pricing).
Details: Defines amount, billing cadence, currency, trial config, and setup fees. Activates paid mode and creates Stripe price record.
Requires: Paid Memberstack subscription, LIVE environment, connected Stripe account, and plan ID.
Returns: Created Price object.

tools.name: createRestrictedUrlGroup
tools.description:
Action: Creates a new gated content group with URLs and access rules.
Use When: Defining new protected website areas, member-only sections, or tiered content access.
Details: Content groups are collections of URLs sharing access requirements. Configure URLs (page paths only, no domain), plan access rules, redirects, and hosted content blocks (HTML, LINK, or FILE for a file uploaded in the dashboard) that only members with access can load.
Requires: Group name and configuration.
Returns: Created content group object.

tools.name: deleteMember
tools.description:
Action: Permanently deletes a member and all associated Memberstack data.
Use When: Data privacy compliance (GDPR), removing test accounts, or handling deletion requests.
Warning: This is irreversible. Removes profile, auth, subscriptions, custom fields, metadata, and all Memberstack data. Verify correct environment (SANDBOX vs LIVE) before deletion. Consider exporting data first.
Requires: Member ID.
Returns: Success confirmation.

confirmationToken.description: Confirmation token returned by a previous call to this tool. Omit it on the first call: the server will describe what would be removed and issue a token. Only supply a token that the server issued, and only after the user has agreed to the described action.
